intent: Inspect and refactor InProcessTelemetryEventBus without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Context Telemetry Stream Intake. @Component implementing TelemetryEventBus over Sinks.many().multicast().onBackpressureBuffer(TelemetryProperties.eventBufferCapacity(), false). publish uses tryEmitNext: on FAIL_OVERFLOW/FAIL_NON_SERIALIZED apply overflowStrategy (REJECT -> Mono.error(IllegalStateException); RETRY -> retry up to retryMaxAttempts spaced by retryBackoff, then error). No sample silently dropped, no blocking. stream returns sink.asFlux(). Constructor(TelemetryProperties).
